# 🔥 High-Retention YouTube Niches — Complete Breakdown

You're 100% right — horror, "caught on camera", and real-life incident content gets **insane retention** (60-75% AVD) compared to the platform average (35-45%). Here's every niche in this space, organized by category.

---

## Why These Niches Dominate Retention

| Factor | How It Works |
|---|---|
| **Fear & Curiosity** | Viewers literally *can't stop watching* — they NEED to see what happens |
| **Binge Loop** | Algorithm serves next video → viewers watch 5-10 in a row (especially at night) |
| **No Face Needed** | All these work as faceless channels — stock footage + narration + editing |
| **Low Production Cost** | Compilation format = curate clips, add voiceover, no filming needed |

---

## 🔴 TIER 1 — Highest Retention Niches (60-75% AVD)

### 1. 👻 Paranormal / Ghost Caught on Camera
- Ghost sightings in houses, hospitals, abandoned buildings
- Poltergeist activity (objects moving on their own)
- Shadow figures on security cameras
- "Real ghost caught on CCTV"
- **Why it works:** Viewers stay to see "is it real or fake?"
- **RPM:** \$3–\$7 (spikes in October/Halloween)

### 2. 🐻 Animal Attacks / Zoo Incidents Caught on Camera
- Zoo animal attacks visitors
- Wild animal encounters (bear, shark, crocodile)
- Safari gone wrong
- Pet attacks owner
- Dog saves owner from attacker
- **Why it works:** Raw survival instinct — fight-or-flight response keeps eyes glued
- **RPM:** \$4–\$8

### 3. 🔪 True Crime / Unsolved Mysteries
- Cold case breakdowns
- Serial killer documentaries
- Missing person investigations
- "The case that police can't explain"
- **Why it works:** Story-driven, viewers watch till the end for the "verdict" or twist
- **RPM:** \$5–\$10

### 4. ⚡ "Seconds Before Disaster"
- Moments right before an accident/natural disaster
- Near-death experiences caught on camera
- Building collapses, bridge failures
- "What went wrong?" engineering breakdowns
- **Why it works:** Tension builds from KNOWING something bad is about to happen
- **RPM:** \$4–\$7

---

## 🟡 TIER 2 — Very High Retention (50-65% AVD)

### 5. 🏠 Security Camera / CCTV Footage
- Creepy things caught on home cameras
- Doorbell camera encounters (intruders, package thieves)
- Ring camera catches unexplained events
- "What my camera recorded while I was asleep"
- **Why it works:** "Found footage" aesthetic = feels real and personal

### 6. 🚗 Dashcam Compilations
- Road rage incidents
- Crazy car crashes
- Near-miss accidents
- Instant karma / justice served on road
- Police chases caught on dashcam
- **Why it works:** Action hits fast, viewers binge clip after clip

### 7. 🛸 Unexplained / Creepy Things Caught on Camera
- UFO sightings
- Cryptid encounters (Bigfoot, Skinwalker, Mothman)
- Strange lights in the sky
- "Things science can't explain"
- Time traveler "evidence"
- **Why it works:** Mystery = curiosity gap = can't stop watching

### 8. 🏃 "If You See This, RUN"
- Dangerous animals you should flee from
- Warning signs in nature
- Creepy places you should never visit
- Survival tips disguised as entertainment
- **Why it works:** Framed as "survival knowledge" — viewers feel they NEED this info

### 9. 🌍 Caught on Google Earth / Google Maps
- Creepy finds on Google Street View
- Hidden locations, abandoned places
- Military secrets visible from satellite
- "Google doesn't want you to see this"
- **Why it works:** Interactive discovery feeling — viewers explore along with narrator

---

## 🟢 TIER 3 — High Retention (45-55% AVD)

### 10. 📋 Top 10 / Countdown Lists (Horror/Mystery)
- "Top 10 scariest videos on the internet"
- "15 creepiest things ever caught on camera"
- "20 moments that will give you chills"
- **Why it works:** Built-in countdown = viewers stay to see #1

### 11. 🌊 Natural Disasters Caught on Camera
- Tsunami, earthquake, tornado footage
- Volcanic eruptions
- Flash floods
- Avalanches
- **Why it works:** Raw power of nature is mesmerizing

### 12. ⚖️ Instant Karma / Justice Served
- Thieves getting caught instantly
- Bullies getting what they deserve
- Scammers exposed on camera
- Road rage backfires
- **Why it works:** Emotional payoff — viewers stay for the satisfying ending

### 13. 🏚️ Exploring Abandoned Places
- Abandoned hospitals, asylums, prisons
- Ghost town explorations
- "We found something terrifying"
- Urban exploration (Urbex)
- **Why it works:** Discovery + danger + mystery = dopamine loop

### 14. 🐍 Dangerous Animals / Nature is Metal
- Predator vs prey (lion vs buffalo, eagle vs snake)
- Ocean creatures (deep sea, sharks)
- "Most dangerous animals in [country]"
- Insects and spiders doing terrifying things
- **Why it works:** Primal fascination with nature's brutality

### 15. 🧠 Disturbing Facts / Dark History
- "Facts that will ruin your day"
- Dark history of famous places
- Creepy Wikipedia rabbit holes
- "Things your teacher never told you"
- **Why it works:** Forbidden knowledge = irresistible curiosity

---

| Niche | Typical RPM | Monetization Risk |
|---|---|---|
| True Crime | \$5–\$10 | ⚠️ Medium — graphic content can get limited ads |
| Paranormal/Horror | \$3–\$7 | ⚠️ Medium — scary content may trigger ad limits |
| Animal Attacks | \$4–\$8 | 🔴 High — violence/gore can get demonetized |
| Dashcam Crashes | \$3–\$6 | 🔴 High — accidents = "not suitable for all advertisers" |
| Countdown/Listicle | \$4–\$8 | 🟢 Low — easiest to keep ad-friendly |
| "If You See This, Run" | \$4–\$7 | 🟢 Low — framed as educational/safety |
| Google Earth | \$3–\$6 | 🟢 Low — very safe content |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Best balance of HIGH RETENTION + SAFE MONETIZATION:**
> - "If You See This, Run" (educational framing)
> - Top 10 Countdown Lists (mystery/horror themed)
> - Caught on Google Earth
> - True Crime (if you avoid graphic visuals)
> - Unexplained Mysteries / UFO

---

## 🏆 Top 5 Niches I'd Recommend Starting With

Based on **retention + monetization safety + ease of content creation**:

| Rank | Niche | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **"If You See This, RUN"** | High retention, ad-safe (educational), easy to make with stock footage |
| 2 | **Top 10 Scariest / Creepiest** | Countdown format forces retention, huge search volume |
| 3 | **True Crime / Unsolved Mysteries** | Highest RPM in this category, extremely binge-worthy |
| 4 | **Paranormal / Ghost Caught on Camera** | Massive audience, Halloween season = views explosion |
| 5 | **Seconds Before Disaster** | Viral format, works as both Shorts and long-form |

---

## 🎯 Content Structure That Gets 60%+ Retention

All these niches use the same formula:

```
Hook (0-5 sec) → "What you're about to see will shock you..."
Tension Build (5-60 sec) → Context, backstory, slow reveal
Payoff (60-90 sec) → The actual scary/shocking moment
Reset → "But that's nothing compared to the next one..."
Repeat → Next clip/story (for compilations)
```

**Pro tips:**
- Drop a micro-hook every 60-90 seconds ("But wait, it gets worse...")
- Remove ALL dead air / silence longer than 0.5 seconds
- Use subtle zoom/pan on images to keep visuals "alive"
- At the 50% mark, tease: "The craziest one is still coming..."

---

6. For the top performers in your list, what's the typical RPM range? Flag any that have high views but low RPM (monetization trap) vs ones that have both high views AND good RPM.
